329:t_2:53.en:
$$マオ$$
「Come on, the details can wait! You go after $$クラマ$$!」

329:t_2:54.en:
$n
「$$宗介$$! He has a score to settle with us over $$常磐$$, too! Finish him with your own hands!」

329:t_2:59.en:
$$クラマ$$
(...To think $c's people would come all the way to $$ナムサク$$...)

329:t_2:60.en:
$$クラマ$$
(Using the $$ファイヤバグ$$ to chase them down was my mistake.)

329:t_2:61.en:
$$クラマ$$
(No, that's not it... What ruined my plan was $$相良$$'s tenacity.)

329:t_2:62.en:
$$クラマ$$
(It's no wonder that $$ガウルン$$ doted on him. That kid... is the same kind of man I am.)

329:t_2:65.en:
$$宗介$$
「You, I'll finish with my own hands!」

329:t_2:66.en:
$$宗介$$
「And then you're going to tell me where $$千鳥$$ is!!」

329:t_2:67.en:
$$クラマ$$
「Don't think things will go your way! What can you do, worn out from all the fighting up to now!」

329:t_2:69.en:
$$クラマ$$
「Looks like you took a couple of rounds head-on. Now I can take my time finishing you...」

329:t_2:71.en:
$$クラマ$$
「Impossible... Why can you still move... after taking bullets head-on...」

329:t_2:72.en:
$$宗介$$
「I don't know either... It must be... rage... that's driving me...」

329:t_2:73.en:
$$クラマ$$
「Heh... To think... I'd be lectured about... willpower... at a time like this...」

329:t_2:74.en:
$$宗介$$
「...Tell me... $$クラマ$$... Where is... $$千鳥$$?」

329:t_2:75.en:
$$クラマ$$
「Rage... my foot... It's the... power of love... isn't it...」

329:t_2:76.en:
$$クラマ$$
「Honestly... because of something so worthless... I...」

329:t_2:78.en:
$$クラマ$$
「$$サン・カルロス$$... or else... $$ニケーロ$$... or $$グラナダ$$...」

329:t_2:79.en:
$$クラマ$$
「...Tch... If I'd known... it would come to this... I never should have... quit smoking...」

329:t_2:80.en:
$$宗介$$
「Not yet... The fight... isn't over...!」

329:t_3:3.en: ～ $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$ Hideout ～

329:t_3:6.en:
$$かなめ$$
「It's not like I have anything else to do.」

329:t_3:7.en:
$$サビーナ$$
「Wouldn't you like to change your clothes soon?」

329:t_3:8.en:
$$かなめ$$
「...It is odd to keep wearing a school uniform forever, but this will make me easier to spot.」

329:t_3:9.en:
$$サビーナ$$
「You still believe help will come...?」

329:t_3:10.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Of course. That's the kind of guy he is.」

329:t_3:11.en:
$$サビーナ$$
「You would do better to stop putting on a brave front.」

329:t_3:12.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I'm not putting on a brave front...!」

329:t_3:13.en:
$$サビーナ$$
「Then why do you look so sad?」

329:t_3:17.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I know that. What I'm asking is where he went and what he's doing.」

329:t_3:18.en:
$$かなめ$$
「You're his secretary, so there's no way you don't know, right?」

329:t_3:19.en:
$$サビーナ$$
「...I cannot give the details, but I'm told he is meeting with an important person.」

329:t_3:20.en:
$$かなめ$$
「The $$サイデリアル$$...? Or someone from $$クロノ$$?」

329:t_3:29.en:
$$レモン$$
「...Thank you for your cooperation, $$プリベンター$$ Wind.」

329:t_3:30.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Not at all... Thanks to you, we could keep the damage to $$ナムサク$$ to a minimum, and we were able to rejoin our comrades.」

329:t_3:31.en:
$$ノイン$$
「Allow us to offer our thanks as well, $$プリベンター$$ Sand.」

329:t_3:32.en:
$$レモン$$
「Ha ha... I never imagined I would meet Wind and Fire, two of the Preventers' top-level executives, in a place like this.」

329:t_3:33.en:
$$ノイン$$
「Were you also acting on $$レディ・アン$$'s orders?」

329:t_3:34.en:
$$レモン$$
「My main mission is to probe $$アマルガム$$'s movements through a route separate from $$ミスリル$$.」

329:t_3:35.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「You were not coordinating with $$ミスリル$$?」

329:t_3:36.en:
$$レモン$$
「Because Commander $$レディ・アン$$'s assessment was that there was a high chance of an $$アマルガム$$ informant inside $$ミスリル$$.」

329:t_3:37.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Is that also why the enemy knew the location of $$メリダ島$$, which was classified top secret...?」

329:t_3:38.en:
$$レモン$$
「I meant to catch hold of $$アマルガム$$'s tail here in $$ナムサク$$, and I never imagined I would end up witnessing the tail being cut off.」

329:t_3:40.en:
$$レモン$$
「Are your wounds all right, $$宗介$$?」

329:t_3:42.en:
$$レモン$$
「You're a tough guy. It's no wonder $$ナミ$$ saw promise in you.」

329:t_3:44.en:
$$レモン$$
「...My making contact with Team $$クロスボウ$$ was a coincidence.」

329:t_3:45.en:
$$レモン$$
「I figured that if I got into some reasonably strong team, the $$オーガ一家$$ would approach us, and I'd get intel on the $$アマルガム$$ behind them.」

329:t_3:47.en:
$$レモン$$
「I was under a different jurisdiction from $c. I didn't know about you either.」

329:t_3:48.en:
$$レモン$$
「But I did know a little about the $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$-equipped ARX-7.」

329:t_3:49.en:
$$宗介$$
「You looked into me because I mentioned the $$アーバレスト$$'s name?」

329:t_3:50.en:
$$レモン$$
「Thanks to that I learned about $c, and thanks to the $$グルフェー$$ commotion, I was able to guide them here like this.」

329:t_3:52.en:
$$レモン$$
「Likewise, $$宗介$$. Even setting the mission aside, the time I spent with $$ナミ$$ and you was enjoyable.」

329:t_3:54.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Still, you pulled a reckless one, man. Trying to take on $$アマルガム$$ all by yourself.」

329:t_3:55.en:
$$マオ$$
「It can't be helped. With no proper means of communication, our calls probably never reached him either.」

329:t_3:56.en:
$$宗介$$
「What happened to that $$アーバレスト$$?」

329:t_3:57.en:
$$マオ$$
「I'm sure you had a vague hunch already, but $$ミスリル$$ has effectively been wiped out.」

329:t_3:59.en:
$$クルツ$$
「But there are other survivors besides us, you know. They say each of them is carrying on the fight in their own way.」

329:t_3:60.en:
$$クルツ$$
「And that AS over there is a present to you from them.」
